subject: mathematics
concept: Collecting and organizing data into a tally chart
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts virtual objects into categories and makes a physical tally as each is placed
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a pictured set of items and completes a tally chart
exercise.abstract: Student converts a written data description into a tally chart

misconception_flags: places an item in the wrong category

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
